visualCharacteristics.purpose: Design moodboard pairing a surface with complementary slabs, paint colours and hardware
visualCharacteristics.description: Bordered two-column mosaic: left a large lead image with an uppercase caption label overlaid, two smaller linked images beneath; right round paint swatches drawn from hex values above product images with captions below

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells. Each image (optionally followed by a caption paragraph, optionally containing one link) becomes a tile. A list item or paragraph containing a hex colour (e.g. **Mocha Cream** / Benjamin Moore / #d3c9bd) becomes a round swatch.
contentPattern.rationale: A fixed set of different content side by side that does not flow as look-alike items: Columns.

usage: Moodboard mosaic. Cell 1: lead image + caption, then further images + captions (a single link in a caption makes the whole tile link there). Cell 2: a list of paints, one item per paint with name, brand and hex code; then product images with captions.
reuseGuidance: Use for design-detail moodboards. For a plain image/text split use columns-teaser.

blockContent.description: Fixed two-column moodboard mosaic: complementary slabs (Quintessa, MacBeth link, Charlestown link) | paint swatches (Mocha Cream #d3c9bd, Northwood Brown #6f6151, Sage Mountain #95917f, Ruby Dusk #6d4243, all Benjamin Moore) and 2 hardware matches with captions

structure.notes: columns-moodboard: one row. Cell 1: Quintessa slab image + caption "Quintessa(TM)"; MacBeth image linked to /quartz-countertops/quartz-colors/designs/macbeth + caption; Charlestown image linked to /quartz-countertops/quartz-colors/designs/charlestown + caption. Cell 2: list of 4 paints, each "Name" (bold), "Benjamin Moore", hex (#d3c9bd Mocha Cream, #6f6151 Northwood Brown, #95917f Sage Mountain, #6d4243 Ruby Dusk); then 2 hardware images each with caption (Kohler Purist Semi-Pro in Vibrant Polished Nickel; Slab style in Dark Brown). columns-teaser: one row. Cell 1: H2 "Experience Cambria in Person", 2 paragraphs, link "Find Cambria near you" (/dealer-locator/locations). Cell 2: kitchen image.
